liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Foolish Heart** (3 reviews): Reviewer calls it possibly the best version ever; Jerry's solo loops around again after the double stop; Reviewer's favorite ever, with an incredible Jerry solo [19][22][24]
- **Morning Dew** (2 reviews): Named by this attendee among the night's standouts, alongside Foolish Heart, Deal and Box of Rain; Reviewer's highpoint and all-time favorite; Brent's organ punctuation is magical, especially in the 'You never' lines [21][22]
- **Desolation Row** (1 review): Jerry adds backing vocals on the mermaids line, giving the song atmosphere and engagement [20]
- **West L.A. Fadeaway** (1 review): Reviewer says Jerry plays on fire; the West L.A.>Desolation Row>Deal stretch is a first-set highlight [20]
- **Terrapin Station** (1 review): Reviewer's favorite version; the closing instrumental is stretched and toyed with for about six and a half minutes [23]
- **Box Of Rain** (1 review): Opened the second set while it rained on the lawn crowd [27]

## Setlist highlights

- **gd1989-07-19d1t01**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [31]
- **gd1989-07-19d1t02**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [31]
- **gd1989-07-19d1t03**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [31]
- **gd1989-07-19d1t04**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [31]
- **gd1989-07-19d1t05**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [31]
- **gd1989-07-19d1t06**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [31]
- **gd1989-07-19d1t07**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [31]
- **gd1989-07-19d1t08**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [31]

## The recordings

- **gd89-07-19.sbd.437.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 167 min; rated 4.68/5 by 105 [1]. Said about its sound: Sound quality is described as near perfect, matching the performance; Reviewer says the recording quality is excellent, bringing the night back [23][27]
- **gd1989-07-19.mtx.hansokolow.96232.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 173 min; rated 4.38/5 by 8 [2]
- **gd1989-07-19.senn441.coniff.gmb.92447.flac16**: source not stated; 20 songs; 162 min; rated 4.4/5 by 5 [3]. Said about its sound: PA audio problems at the start of Hell In A Bucket; drums mostly cut and space cut into [3]
- **gd1989-07-19.138818.UltraMatrix.sbd.miller.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 19 songs; 178 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [7]

## Around the show

- Attendee at shows one and three recalls abundant mud and amazing music this night [21]
- Rain left the grass a mess; the reviewer was glad to have reserved seating [22]
- It rained at all three Alpine shows; reviewer's first time at this venue [25]
- Reviewer sat soaked on the lawn in rain; a rainbow appeared over the valley as the second set opened [27]
- This was the band's last Alpine Valley show before the local city council banned them [30]
- Band tuned up Beer Barrel Polka after Althea; crossfades cover tape flips after Althea and before Lovelight [3]
- Mexican Hat Dance tuning came before Victim Or The Crime [7]
- Reviewer sees 1989 and early 1990 as the Brent years, with many shows where Brent is superb [23]
- Reviewer considers this the best of the three Alpine shows [24]
- Reviewer ranks the three Alpine shows among favorite outdoor shows seen, with Brent and Jerry both strong [25]
- The three-night run is held up as a peak of late-period Dead and fed the Downhill From Here video [30]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd89-07-19.sbd.437.sbeok.shnf**: source: DSBD> DAT> CD> eac> SHN [1]
- **gd1989-07-19.mtx.hansokolow.96232.flac16**: transferred by hansokolow; source: Matrix mix (SBD/AUD) [2]. Also: Hansokolow matrix in ProTools; Sennheiser 441 audience tape by Casey Coniff in front of repeater stack, transferred by Bill Koucky in 2008; Audience source gear: Sennheiser 441 into Marantz PDM 340 with dbx, onto Maxell MX-S 90 cassette master [2]
- **gd1989-07-19.senn441.coniff.gmb.92447.flac16**: taped by Casey Coniff; transferred by Bill Koucky; source: Sennheiser 441 > Marantz PDM 340 w/ dbx (Cassette Master Maxell MX-S 90) [3]
- **gd1989-07-19.138818.UltraMatrix.sbd.miller.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Ultra Matrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-XG90) [7]. Also: Ultramatrix SBD built from two master sets to be complete; fixes 138808 by cleaning PA static in Sugaree [7]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Kirsten Michel: [1989-07-19 Alpine Valley Music Theatre, East Troy, WI, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1989-07-19-alpine-valley-music-theatre-east-troy-wi-usa/) [32]
